description:
The 55th Contracting Squadron has an ongoing requirement to acquire an A-37B Dragonfly aircraft to serve as a static display at the 2026 Offutt Air Force Base "Defenders of Freedom" Air and Space Show. the show will be held on Offutt Air Force Base, Nebraska on August 8th and August 9th, 2026. Please see the attached Statement of Work for additional information.

If you can provide the specified aircraft, please email the listed point of contact with the following information:

  1. Entity Name
  2. UEI/GAGE
  3. Business Size
  4. Entity POC
